title: Monotonicity of the emission property
statement: Fix a Boolean parameter $\ell$, natural numbers $n,i,B$, and an oracle assigning a Boolean answer to each of five deciders and each bit string. If a configuration satisfies the emission property for a segment $S$ starting at $k$ with postcondition $P$, and every configuration satisfying $P$ also satisfies $Q$, then it satisfies the emission property for the same segment and starting position with postcondition $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The emission property for $S$ from $a$ with postcondition $P$.
